# Codex IT

## Site Summary
Codex IT is a modern digital and IT solutions company dedicated to building technology systems that truly work for businesses and people. We deliver end-to-end solutions combining software development, digital platforms, and IT infrastructure.

## Primary Audience
Businesses seeking custom software development, web and mobile applications, cloud hosting, VPS solutions, digital marketing, and IT infrastructure services — from startups to established enterprises.
